versions.changelog: v1.0.12 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

Security hardening from the ClawHub review: added scripts/svg_safety.py as the shared gate for untrusted SVG input (refuses scripts, foreignObject/iframe/object/embed, remote fonts, @import, and any non-local href/src or CSS url() reference). The render sandbox now serves exactly one URL and uses that same single-origin endpoint as Chrome's only proxy with the implicit loopback bypass disabled, so a crafted asset cannot reach other loopback services (closes the reported loopback SSRF). The GIF path uses the same gate with shell-free, timeout-bounded external calls, and every process launch goes through one funnel. Also fixed false positives: gradient/pattern surfaces are reported as notices instead of failures, and the edge scan now uses median deviation so full-bleed gradients pass while real edge clipping still fails.

- Removed extensive documentation and asset files, including all README, license, progress, upgrade plans, images, SVGs, and related docs.
- The skill definition, description, requirements, and workflow remain unchanged.
- All standalone guides, visual documentation, and sample assets are now maintained externally (refer to linked repository for usage and help).
- This version significantly reduces the repository footprint by shifting documentation and assets outside the codebase.

audit_readme.py repo-boundary check: refuse image refs resolving outside the README tree (../.., root-absolute, drive, file://) so a crafted README cannot trigger file probes outside the project folder

Harden visual_verify.py render sandbox: repo-boundary check for SVG refs, static rejection of remote/absolute refs, pre-render gate skips SVGs with script/foreignObject, single-file isolated serve dir
Remove showcase PR workflow (references/showcase-contribution.md) and agents/openai.yaml; attribution passive-only; no fork/branch/PR capability documented
Add activation gate to description + Activation policy section (Vague Triggers finding)
Declare allowed-tools frontmatter (SkillSpector LP3 least privilege); passive-only attribution guide in svg-production.md
Bilingual zh/en short_description in agents/openai.yaml (drives ClawHub skill summary)
Remove proactive attribution/showcase solicitation - passive-only response to explicit user requests
Declare runtime permissions (requires.anyBins) for MCP least privilege; isolate SVG render network (DNS blocked except loopback); bilingual zh/en description; add skill-card

v1.0.0: Upgrade of oil-oil/beautify-github-readme (MIT) - full upstream workflow and design references preserved, plus render-level visual verification (scripts/visual_verify.py: headless Chrome/Edge, WCAG contrast, edge-clipping scan), Windows/Microsoft YaHei font adaptation, dark/light theme-safety rules, bilingual README (ZH/EN).
